title: Compliance posture view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's compliance view: compliance posture per framework and per boundary over every declared (boundary, framework) pair, each assessed by its newest recorded compliance assessment. It reads the current declarations and assessments; the filter's as_of is not applied. Coverage is kept per framework, never blended into one number. Fleet-wide only: Core refuses a product or team scope. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

by_framework.description: One row per declared framework, by framework id.

by_scope.description: One row per declared boundary, by boundary name.

allOf.$comment: A framework row is keyed by its framework and covers only it.

rollup.description: One group's declared (boundary, framework) pairs, how many are assessed, and the summed coverage of their newest assessments, per framework.

key.description: The framework id (by_framework) or the boundary name, raw (by_scope).

pairs.description: Declared (boundary, framework) pairs in the group.

assessed.description: Of those, the pairs with a recorded assessment.

coverage.description: Each declared framework's summed coverage counts; a pair with no assessment adds zeros.
A framework's coverage counts: the compliance assessment's own coverage block, summed over the group's pairs (a pair with no assessment adds zeros).
